SHARED-F-2-S13.title: Consent Persistence Schema and Storage
SHARED-F-2-S13.description: Design and implement MongoDB schema for storing consent tiers, timestamps, user identifiers (when permitted), and audit fields. Ensure compatibility with de-identified storage when Tier 2 is not granted.

SHARED-F-2-S14.title: Consent API Endpoints and Enforcement Hooks
SHARED-F-2-S14.description: Expose consent capture, upgrade, and status-check endpoints via FastAPI. Integrate enforcement hooks into tool_router and application facades to block or modify data handling based on consent tier.

SHARED-F-2-S15.title: Consent Audit Logging and Traceability
SHARED-F-2-S15.description: Implement audit logging for all consent events including capture, upgrade, denial, and enforcement actions. Ensure logs are de-identified where required and aligned with HIPAA traceability expectations.

SHARED-F-2-S16.title: Pydantic Consent Models and Validation Contracts
SHARED-F-2-S16.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for consent inputs, tier transitions, and API contracts. Ensure strict validation and alignment with existing consent_models patterns.
